findings.title: The opening name anticipates the worship command
findings.claim: The basmala names Allah before the command to worship the Lord of this House, so the later imperative reads as directed toward the one named at the opening and turns the formula into a threshold for the ensuing house-centered obligation.
findings.mechanism: The focus carriers are the construct noun for name and the fixed divine proper name; the independent trigger is the later imperative to worship the Lord of the House. Their sequence lets the proper name orient the command, while the ordered movement and closing provision place that command within the community's pericope.
findings.reader_payoff: The reader can see why the opening invocation belongs to the command that follows: the name already gives the worship imperative its forward-facing addressee.
findings.containment: The relation is supplied by sequence and context, not an explicit equation between the opening proper name and the later title Rabb of this House. The formula remains an invocation, and the later command remains a distinct act.

epistemic.reason: The command and proper name are directly present in the supplied surface and a trusted publication states the forward link; the direction from invocation to command is still a contextual inference, and one supporting walk is legacy_unbound.
